svg.aria-label: CRM: Customer 360, sales pipeline, quotes and dealer networks, with role-based access control and a complete audit trail. MES: Work orders, shop-floor data capture and real-time production tracking and reporting. WMS: Receiving, put-away, picking and shipping, driven by barcode-based mobile workflows. ERP integrations: Reliable two-way sync of customers, products, orders and invoices, including multi-company setups. AI & automation: LLM-powered assistants and AI agents that automate sales and back-office workflows. Customer discovery: Lead generation pipelines that find potential customers, enrich company data and score leads. Mobile apps: iOS and Android apps and installable PWAs for sales, field and shop-floor teams. Real-time collaboration: Live messaging, notifications and video meetings built into business apps.
